scientific_integrity: The argument uses standard entropy scaling for continuous flows, ergodic decomposition for the sampled homeomorphism, and the variational principle. No computation or finite experiment substitutes for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The transfer requires entropy witnesses invariant under the whole flow, not merely witnesses for the time-one map. It proves entropy flexibility for each nonzero time map but does not preserve strict ergodicity or uniqueness under resonant sampling, and it addresses only finite target entropy levels.
title: Flow-realized entropy flexibility passes to every nonzero time map
